author: session_research_branch
context: exp030a 全部门槛通过(概念组残差动量,pooled fold2+fold3 +0.006373,official valid +0.006156,优于 shuffled 负对照)。但 exp030a 的信号使用滚动历史(截面 t 的历史 = t 前 W 个截面),Test 段标签不可得、历史无法滚动。本诊断检验冻结历史变体:每个评估窗口内所有截面共用『窗口开始前 W 个截面』的组残差快照,精确模拟 Test 部署形态(历史冻结在 [3151,3161) 对全部 442 个 Test 截面)。
mechanism: per window [start,stop): frozen history = sections [start-W, start); signal for every t in window built from that single snapshot via current-section category mapping; candidate = (1-alpha)*rank01(base) + alpha*rank01(signal)

window_frozen_snapshots.fold_1_note: skipped: proxy history only exists from 1459, no clean pre-window snapshot for fold_1

preregistered_parameters.selection_rule: choose (alpha, W) maximizing pooled fold2+fold3 mean delta subject to fold2>0, fold3>0, min rank corr>=0.995 on both folds, worst 32-section block>=-0.002 on both folds, momentum pooled > shuffled pooled
preregistered_parameters.holdout: official valid evaluated once with frozen parameters

decay_reporting: per-section distance_from_snapshot recorded; mean delta by distance quartile reported for official valid (243 sections) as horizon-extrapolation evidence toward Test's 442 sections; no gate on decay itself
stop_rules: 任何门槛失败:结论为『信号真实但冻结部署不成立』,不生成 Test 候选;滚动递归自举部署需用户另行决策
不以事后扩大网格或改用混合冻结/滚动复活
若全部通过:立即以冻结参数生成 exp030c Test 候选(底座 exp024b,前 6 截面保留),仍不自动提交、不覆盖正式文件

compliance.no_future_features: 每个窗口的冻结快照严格在窗口开始之前;Test 部署时快照=[3151,3161) valid 已知标签
